svg.title: Pose Parallax common pose pool
svg.desc: Each pose shown from the front and at 60 degrees. Green is anatomical left, blue is right, cyan is center. All poses belong to one randomly selected pool.
svg.text: POSE PARALLAX — 24 POSES / ONE COMMON POOL
Front and 60° views · Green: left / Blue: right / Cyan: center · Lines indicate the floor
